programme.title: Inside Classical
programme.desc: Owain Wyn Evans presents a concert from the BBC National Orchestra of Wales, including spooky film favourites including John Williams' Harry Potter and Jaws. Plus, Bach's gothic masterpiece Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Saint-Saëns' Danse Macabre and Rimsky-Korsakov's arrangement of Mussorgsky's Night on the Bare Mountain

programme.title: Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius
programme.desc: The documentary drama continues with the Bard at the top of his game. He is writing and acting with the Lord Chamberlain's Men and producing hit after hit - A Midsummer Night's Dream, Henry IV and Julius Caesar. But as his star rises, a series of disasters and setbacks strike, throwing Shakespeare's life, purpose and family into chaos. Narrated by Juliet Stevenson, with contributions from Judi Dench, Brian Cox, Adrian Lester, Lolita Chakrabarti, Helen Mirren, Martin Freeman and Jessie

programme.title: A Stitch in Time
programme.desc: Amber Butchart explores the lives of historical figures through the clothes they wore, focusing on Edward of Woodstock (1330-1376), the so-called Black Prince. She reveals how the effigy of the son of Edward III provides many pointers as to the personality and attitude of this warrior prince both in terms of its heraldic symbolism and its flamboyance

programme.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands
programme.desc: New Zealand is now home to some of the richest agricultural land in the world, boasting magnificent gardens with plants from around the planet and rare magical creatures. A caving expedition reveals relics of the original lost world of its pre-human past; the actual bones of a cow-sized flightless grazing bird, a moa, among the largest birds that has ever lived. However, as narrator Sam Neill reveals, against all the odds, one giant bird from primeval New Zealand has survived to this day

programme.title: The Latest Secrets of Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the latest research into the creation of the ancient Egyptians' written language. The programme follows Egyptologists as they unlock the texts inscribed inside a richly adorned tomb, revealing the beliefs and lives of the priests, scribes, painters, engravers and builders who created this grand funerary monument

programme.title: Classic Mastermind

programme.title: Call My Bluff

programme.title: Chris Terrill Remembers - Soho Stories
programme.desc: The year 1996 saw the peak of Britpop, the divorce of Charles and Diana and England hosting the European Football Championship, but also saw the beginnings of new TV genre docusoap with Chris Terrill's series Soho Stories. Armed with a single camera, Chris embedded himself in the heart of this multi-faceted community, charting their lives, their work, relationships, religion, and fears. He reveals how his career as an anthropologist provided the inspiration for the series and how the invention of a new type of video camera made it a reality

programme.title: Soho Stories

programme.title: Ancient Worlds
programme.sub-title: City of Man, City of God
programme.desc: Richard Miles explores the rise and fall of the Roman empire, which at the height of its power, extended the benefits of its civilisation to a staggering 60 million subjects and citizens, from Hadrian's Wall to the banks of the Euphrates. The archaeologist and historian also learns how the expansion of Christianity filled a gap left by the Roman multi-god belief system, eventually leading to the instalment of Constantine as the first Christian emperor

programme.desc: Ben Garrod explores how skin has evolved to enable animals to move in a range of habitats, revealing how adaptations allow birds to fly, sharks to speed through water and sugar gliders to take to the air

programme.title: The Normans
programme.desc: Professor Robert Bartlett examines the impact of the conquest of Britain and Ireland, and learns how William the Conqueror built scores of castles and cathedrals to impose his control and intimidate the population. The ruler also commissioned the Domesday Book to survey the wealth of the land and raise revenue, and set in motion the linguistic and cultural transformation of England. The Normans blended well in Scotland, but faced fierce opposition in Wales, and promoted divisions in Ireland which some claim still exist to this day

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: The story of Kwame Brathwaite, the Harlem photographer, activist and cultural pioneer whose work helped define the iconic Black Is Beautiful movement. Across a career spanning more than seven decades, Kwame captured over 500,000 images documenting African American life, creativity and identity, while championing Black pride through photography, fashion and grassroots activism

programme.title: Light and Dark

Chloe and Peter's garden has a strict tree preservation order on four of the trees. The couple envision a blend of arts and crafts and French formality in their new garden. programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and the team create a garden for a family with twin girls who have a serious, life-limiting condition. Three-year-olds Darcie and Evie Chapman have been diagnosed with Dravet syndrome, a very rare form of epilepsy, and parents Mark and Natalie must be on permanent watch to prevent their daughters' seizures leading to something more serious. The Chapmans' current outdoor space is unsuitable for the girls, with changes of levels, colours of plants and even the light through branches influencing their condition, so the crew follows the rules of a formal garden where straight lines, order and symmetry give an unfussy overall look

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: It's a busy start to the shift as all crews are diverted to a fire at Forest Gate Police Station, leaving 57 patients waiting for an ambulance in north-east London alone. An emergency call is received for a 54-year-old female suffering with chest pain. Crewmates Ellis and Jade are dispatched and on arrival, learn the patient struggles with alcohol dependency. programme.title: My Family
programme.desc: The Harpers gather to celebrate Christmas once more - although unlike previous festive specials, this one reveals how the family will be faring 30 years from now. Ben is in his eighties and still as grumpy as ever, thanks to 'a little moisturiser' Susan has not aged a bit, Janey is tipping the scales at a whopping 20 stone and Michael is trying to hide his baldness with an unconvincing wig. While Susan is put out that grandson Kenzo, now 38, has not come to visit for Christmas, Ben is quick to point out that they have had some of the worst festive holidays ever, and this one looks no different with a 'greed gift exchange', a rival cousin and a nativity play battle. Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker star, with a guest appearance from Nathaniel Parker. Festive special from 2009

programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: Property Brothers: Under Pressure
programme.desc: Nancy and Addam made the emotional leap of buying their first home, but their renovation budget has been pushed to the edge - along with their clashing styles

programme.title: DIY SOS
programme.desc: Nick Knowles comes to the aid of Liz and Jason Liversidge, a Hull couple in desperate need of help in future-proofing their family home. Not long after getting married and starting a family, Jason was diagnosed with both Fabrys disease, which causes a build-up of poisonous toxins in the body, and Motor Neurone Disease, which drastically reduced his life expectancy. The pair also discovered that Jason would have passed Fabrys disease on to his two daughters, which means that once her husband is gone, Liz will need all the help she can get in managing her children's condition. Nick joins forces with designer Oliver Heath and an army of volunteers to put together a home in which Jason can build meaningful memories with his girls, but one which also gives Liz the best chance of providing for their future needs

programme.title: DIY SOS
programme.desc: Nick Knowles is in Loughborough to meet a family of five, whose identical twin babies have been diagnosed as having a form of dwarfism, while at the age of 41, dad Mark is recovering from aggressive bowel and liver cancer. Now they are struggling for space. Having heard of their plight, the DIY SOS team turns up to transform their home, backed up by an army of local tradespeople, with designer Gabrielle Blackman on hand to ensure they don't stray too far from her vision

programme.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
programme.sub-title: Nugget, Tetley and the Police Pups
programme.desc: Pete meets Chow Chow Nugget who has a longer stay than planned, three-legged Tetley, and some Belgium Malinois puppies training to be service dogs

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: Paramedics attend a father and son whose car has been hit by a falling tree on a dark and stormy night, and are called out to assist a homeless woman sheltering in a bin shed

programme.title: Surviving Fred and Rose West: Inside Cromwell Street
programme.desc: Documentary following the journey of Kathleen Richards, one of the last surviving victims of abuse at 25 Cromwell Street, and her path towards healing. In 1977, 17-year-old Kathleen Richards moves into 25 Cromwell Street, and soon finds herself groomed, abused and trapped inside a house where no one can protect her

programme.title: Surviving Fred and Rose West: Inside Cromwell Street
programme.desc: After escaping Fred and Rose West, Kathleen Richards buries her trauma. But when their crimes are exposed, she must confront Rose face to face

programme.title: The Killing of James Bulger
programme.desc: An in-depth look at the abduction and murder of toddler James Bulger, which shocked the nation in 1993, and continues to resonate to this day. In February 1993, police are alerted when two-year-old James vanishes in a shopping mall. Hours later, CCTV reveals the child with two boys - but then a body is found

programme.title: Ski A&E

programme.desc: Interior designer Banjo Beale and his team of tradespeople transforms a family-run fish shop in Tobermory on the Isle of Mull. The job is a commission from Banjo's friend Sally, who is the manager and wants to modernise the traditional business

programme.title: Designing the Hebrides
programme.desc: Interior designer Banjo Beale and his team of tradespeople update a crumbling bothy on the small island of Ulva, which locals want to rent out to visitors. With no power, water or easy access, Banjo has his work cut out, but the help of handyman Tom, painter Lisa, and his husband Ro enable him to embark on his most challenging design brief to date
